Rule.name: HR Set Inactive
Rule.Description: Computes the lock status from startDate and endDate of the HR source.

Rule.name: HR Leaver Trigger
Rule.Description: Matches only when an end date is set and reached; separates the leaver case from the joiner case.

Rule.name: HR Derive Account Name
Rule.Description: Derives a unique account name (first initial plus last name) for the create policies of the target systems.
